value=0

print(''.join(encoder.iterencode(value)))

import json
mapping={10:'ten',2:'two'}
options={'sort_keys':True}
encoder=json.JSONEncoder(**options)
print(json.dumps(mapping,**options))
print(encoder.encode(mapping))
print(''.join(encoder.iterencode(mapping)))
